> import lodepng
> import numpy as np
> # Create a simple digit 0 (28x28, grayscale)
> # We'll create a numpy array of shape (28,28) with values 255 for background and 0 for the digit.
> # Actually we want a pixelated 0. Let's create a simple 0 with lines.
> # We'll create a 28x28 array of 0, then draw a 0.
> img = np.zeros((28, 28), dtype=np.uint8)
> # Draw the outer square
> for i in range(28):
>     img[i, 0] = 255
>     img[i, 27] = 255
>     img[0, i] = 255
>     img[27, i] = 255
> # Draw the inner square (shifted)
> for i in range(4, 24):
>     img[i, 4] = 255
>     img[i, 23] = 255
>     img[4, i] = 255
>     img[23, i] = 255
> # Draw the top bar
> for i in range(4, 24):
>     img[i, 10] = 255
> # Draw the bottom bar
> for i in range(4, 24):
>     img[i, 17] = 255
> # Save as PNG
> with open('image.png', 'wb') as f:
>     lodepng.encode(f, img, 28, 28, 1)
> print('Created image.png')
> EOF

root@fe6c8862fa9b:/app# cat > generate_image.c << 'EOF'
> #include <stdio.h>
> #include <stdlib.h>
> #include "lodepng.h"
> #include <math.h>
>
> // Create a simple digit 0 (28x28, grayscale)
> int main() {
>     unsigned int width = 28, height = 28;
>     unsigned char* image = malloc(width * height);
>     // Draw the digit 0
>     for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
>         for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
>             // Outer square
>             if (x == 0 || x == width-1 || y == 0 || y == height-1) {
>                 image[y*width + x] = 255;
>             } else {
>                 // Inner square (shifted)
>                 if (x >= 4 && x <= 23 && y >= 4 && y <= 23) {
>                     image[y*width + x] = 255;
>                 } else {
>                     // Top bar
>                     if (y >= 4 && y <= 23 && x == 10) {
>                         image[y*width + x] = 255;
>                     } else {
>                         // Bottom bar
>                         if (y >= 4 && y <= 23 && x == 17) {
>                             image[y*width + x] = 255;
>                         } else {
>                             // Inside inner square (top and bottom bars already drawn)
>                             // Actually we need to fill inner square fully
>                             // Let's redo: we'll fill inner square first, then top and bottom bars.
>                             // We'll restructure.
>                             image[y*width + x] = 0;
>                         }
>                     }
>                 }
>             }
>         }
>     }
>     // Actually the above is messy. Let's fill inner square first, then top and bottom bars.
>     // We'll restructure: create a new approach.
>     // Instead, we'll use a simple algorithm: fill the whole image with 255, then draw the digit as black.
>     // Let's do that.
>     // First, allocate again.
>     free(image);
>     image = malloc(width * height);
>     // Fill with 255 (white)
>     for (int i = 0; i < width * height; i++) {
>         image[i] = 255;
>     }
>     // Draw the digit 0 as black
>     // Outer square
>     for (int i = 0; i < width; i++) {
>         image[i] = 0;
>         image[(width-1)*width + i] = 0;
>     }
>     for (int j = 0; j < height; j++) {
>         image[j*width] = 0;
>         image[(height-1)*width + j] = 0;
>     }
>     // Inner square (4 to 23 inclusive)
>     for (int i = 4; i <= 23; i++) {
>         for (int j = 4; j <= 23; j++) {
>             image[j*width + i] = 0;
>         }
>     }

root@fe6c8862fa9b:/app# cat > /app/create_image.cpp << 'EOF'
> #include <lodepng_cpp.h>
> #include <vector>
> #include <iostream>
>
> int main() {
>     // Create a 28x28 grayscale image
>     std::vector<unsigned char> image(28 * 28);
>     for (int i = 0; i < 28 * 28; i++) {
>         image[i] = 255;  // white
>     }
>     // Draw the digit 0
>     // Outer square
>     for (int i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
>         image[i] = 0;
>         image[(28-1)*28 + i] = 0;
>     }
>     for (int j = 0; j < 28; j++) {
>         image[j*28] = 0;
>         image[(28-1)*28 + j] = 0;
>     }
>     // Inner square (4 to 23 inclusive)
>     for (int i = 4; i <= 23; i++) {
>         for (int j = 4; j <= 23; j++) {
>             image[j*28 + i] = 0;
>         }
>     }
>     // Top bar (x=10, y=4..23)
>     for (int y = 4; y <= 23; y++) {
>         image[y*28 + 10] = 0;
>     }
>     // Bottom bar (x=17, y=4..23)
>     for (int y = 4; y <= 23; y++) {
>         image[y*28 + 17] = 0;
>     }
>     // Save
>     lodepng::save_file("image.png", image, 28, 28, 1);
>     return 0;
> }
> EOF
